items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: I remember Fred Starkey used to have his, uh, his treasured Jabbo Smiths.

ctx.x: No, no. I still, I have to interrupt you again on another point. What was the jazz club like in Australia? You know, they're different here.

Uh-huh. Yeah, well, the jazz club in Sydney, um, well, it, it started out as, um, so I imagine, as a group of fellows who used to play instruments and got together, and they started, uh, they hired a, a cheap hall in town and they used to play it for Saturday night just for their own enjoyment and then they opened the doors to see if people would come in. Well, um, um, when I first started going down there, they didn't get very many people, they used to get 50 or 100 people a night, on a Saturday night. Um, and…
